last_episode_to_air.name: Zafar Defeated
last_episode_to_air.overview: Rukhsar arrives with the locket containing Zafar's room and manages to turn the tide in their favour. Later, Aladdin delivers the finishing strike to Zafar, and everyone celebrates their victory. They come back to the castle and help Aladdin and Yasmine with their marriage ceremonies.

name: Aladdin - Naam Toh Suna Hoga
overview: Aladdin is an age-old fantasy tale of a 20-year-old boy and his travails around his family and love. It is an absolute family entertainer show. It has got the fantastical factor of classic tale as well as the nail-biting thriller, heart-warming romance and affecting family equations. Despite being set in a very old legendary talismanic era, all the characters are entertaining, yet relatable which makes the fans correlate with its humor.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
Mallika, a powerful and evil sorceress, plans to take over the world. Her servant Hassan tricks her but then turns into a genie and gets trapped in a lamp.

500 years later, a boy named Aladdin was born in Baghdad. He is a kind hearted child. He is tasked by the evil Grand Vizier of Baghdad, Zafar, to find a lamp in exchange for 10,000 gold coins, but is trapped in a cave. He rubs the lamp and becomes the master of The Lamp's Genie. He names Ginni as Ginnu. Zafar tries to steal the lamp from Aladdin but fails.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A year later, Aladdin is shown to be still alive. He finds The Ring's Genie and discovers Zafar's crimes. He vows to take revenge and takes the name Ali. It is shown that his father Omar and uncle Bulbul saved him before he was killed, the latter having his father killed while saving Aladdin. Ali and his genie (ring chhap) find two more jinns - Jin Mine and Chand Changezi.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: 18 years later, Aladdin is shown as the spoilt and lazy prince of Turkistan and Yasmine as a kind-hearted, ordinary thief. After Aladdin manages to catch her, they are banished from Turkistan, and they reach Baghdad along with Ginu. They start taking lessons from Rukhsaar, the principal of Baghdad's school (all the four have no memory of their past life). Gradually, Aladdin regains his memory about his previous life.
